newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Telstra quiet on A$3 bln debt financing report.
newsitem.headline: Telstra quiet on A$3 bln debt financing report.

text.p: State-owned telecommunications group Telstra Corp said on Tuesday it would not make any comment on a newspaper report that it was about to raise up to A$3 billion in debt financing.

The Australian Financial Review reported on Tuesday that Telstra is expected later this week to announce that it has appointed J.P. Morgan and C.S. First Boston to work on a debt financing programme worth up to A$3 billion.
The paper reported that the debt financing would fund the payment of a A$2 billion to A$3 billion special dividend to the Australian government.
